THE FESTIVAL

Minda Muda. Perniagaan Global.Young Minds. Global Business.

Platform untuk mencetus idea, membina keyakinan dan menghubungkan bakat muda dengan dunia sebenar.A platform to spark ideas, build confidence and connect young talents with the real world.

International MindBizz Fest 2026

Program mengetengahkan pengalaman pembelajaran berasaskan inovasi, keusahawanan dan kolaborasi melalui pertandingan, aktiviti kesukanan, perkongsian ilmu, pameran dan aktiviti korporat.

The festival highlights innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration through competitions, sports, knowledge sharing, exhibitions and corporate activities.

Fokus FestivalFestival Focus

  • Menggalakkan pemikiran kreatif dan penyelesaian masalah.
  • Meningkatkan kemahiran komunikasi, pitching dan pemasaran.
  • Membina jaringan antara pelajar, institusi dan komuniti.
  • Mendedahkan peserta kepada teknologi dan peluang perniagaan.
  • Mewujudkan pengalaman pembelajaran yang menyeronokkan dan bermakna.
  • Encourage creative thinking and problem solving.
  • Develop communication, pitching and marketing skills.
  • Build networks among students, institutions and communities.
  • Expose participants to technology and business opportunities.
  • Create an engaging and meaningful learning experience.
